paper_metadata.title: Microstructure evolution and mechanical properties of ZrC-added Nb–16Si–20Ti alloys

evidence.section: 4.2. Room-temperature fracture toughness and compressive properties of ZrC addition
evidence.quote: The enlarged view of Fig. 7 (c) proves that the large-size Nbss phase can promote crack deflection.
